text_block_list.text:
Morning. While sorting through paperwork,
I received a message from Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ""I was completely out with a cold yesterday, but as you can see, I'm fully recovered today!""
Attached to the message was a photo of a thermometer showing a normal body temperature.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: One, two, three, four!
choice_data_list: Huh? Your racing outfit?! What's the matter?
Huh? Your racing outfit?! What happened?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yes! Since my cold cleared up, I wanted to wear the outfit that gets me most fired up!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh♪
In short, it's this! THIS!!
She pointed ostentatiously at the part of her outfit designed with the kanji for 'Strength'.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Well, just you watch!
I thought I'd be lucky if I could just get in some light movement today... but.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaahhhhh--!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: How was it!?
choice_data_list: Amazing, your time improved from before!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~♪
That's roughly how it's done!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
After all,
it's got the word "strength" right in it!
choice_data_list: That's quite a special design, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yes! I raced once before when recovering from an illness, just like today.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: It was just a small tournament between kids, but—

text_block_list.name: Adult A
text_block_list.text: You don't have to push yourself to run, you know?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm completely fine!
See? I'm in top shape!

text_block_list.name: Adult B
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...? Don't push yourself too hard.
If you ruin your health again, you'll be the one suffering.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone... is worrying about me.
...I'm grateful for their kindness... but...)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (I can't go on like this...!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Hey, does anyone have a marker!?
(Squeak squeak!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"That's 'Strength' done...
Now for the next character..."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: *Gulp*! ...Alright!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(I am strong! I am strong!
...After all, my name is...!!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*...
I won... I really won!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha! Your hands are pitch black~.
You really worked up a sweat, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
But... that's why... this is my pride.
...My medal of honor.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: And so, I started to think that way.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Feelings dwell within words, and those words become strength.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"These clothes were embroidered with the character for 'Strength.'
With this word with me, I know I can stand back up."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...As many times as it takes!
choice_data_list: Makes you want to wear that and run every day, doesn't it?
Maybe I'll give it a try too.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I understand! But... we can't do that!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
When I first received my outfit, I was so happy
that I practically wore it every single day, but...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I went way too all-out,
and the people around me had to stop me!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "So this outfit is called to action on days like today, when I'm really rarin' to go!"

If the jersey worn daily had "Strength" printed on it...
it would fire them up and serve as great support!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Please do! By all means!
I'd be so, so happy!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
With us matching, Trainer,
we can become way, way stronger together!
